title: 86. How do I design a survey to publish results with or without personal information?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I design a survey to publish results with or without personal information.
short_answer: If you want to let your participants choose, whether their personal information will be published along with their answers, follow these instructions (https://circabc.europa.eu/sd/d/e68ff760-226f-40e9-b7cb-d3dcdd04bfb1/How_to_publish_survey_results_anonymously.pdf) to build the survey to fit these requirements.
